payload.blocks: Phase 3 (integration) of plan 261126-0853, the plan's last phase. The p03c worktree of plan 261124-2143 blocks nothing; it only holds disk.

But fgos mailbox send from this confined session exits 1, the confined-mail gap that plan 261125-2313 is fixing, and SendMessage lists no reachable agent. My own git -C checkout in the worktree is refused with a read-only file system.

scope.allows: One npm test run and one cargo test --workspace run on main, with results written into the named report; discarding the 3 dirty files in worktree p03c and removing it with fgos worktree remove --delivered-to main --discard-ignored.

parts.what: Two jobs need an unconfined session. (1) Plan 261126-0853 phase 3 needs npm test and cargo test --workspace run on main. The lead could not run them: npm test fails with EROFS on the full-suite lock, and the sandbox shows 22 cargo failures outside the plan's files. (2) Worktree 261124-2143-head-lifecycle-events-p03c has 3 dirty files, but they add nothing main lacks, and its branch is already contained in main.
